title: Four in the Morning
subtitle: 地震防范 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 地震防范（灾害防范·地震与自救）
meta: 主题语境：地震防范（灾害防范·地震与自救）　|　核心词汇：alarm　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 alarm 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the ① alarm went off at four in the morning, and my grandmother said later that she had known the sound for thirty-one years and had never once known what it meant. She said an ② alarm is the only thing in a house that is built to be wrong, and that this is why people stop hearing them; an alarm, she said, is a word for a sound you hope is a mistake.

The ③ alarm clock on the shelf was the only one in the street that kept time, and my grandfather wound it at nine every night for forty years. He ④ raised the alarm in 1968, when the wall of the school moved, and he was thanked and nothing was done, and he said raising the alarm is the only job that ends in thanks.

My mother woke ⑤ in alarm in 1976 and carried my brother out without putting on a coat, and she has never admitted being frightened. There was ⑥ no alarm in the new houses by 1981, meaning no box on the wall, and my grandmother said a house without an alarm is a house that believes itself; an alarm, she said, is the cheapest thing you can buy against the last hour.

The ⑦ alarm in her face, the only time I ever saw it, was in 1984, when the letter came. He fitted a ⑧ burglar alarm in 1986 and never switched it on, and he said an alarm you do not switch on is the same as an alarm you do not have, and my grandmother said it is not the same at all.

The  alarm I would keep, if I kept one, is the one at four in the morning in 1976, which was the ground and not the box. An  alarm, my father said in 1990, is the only sound a house makes on purpose, and the only one nobody has ever learned to like; every alarm, he said, is about something that has already happened.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. 警报装置；报警器
E. 固定搭配：alarm clock 闹钟
F. 固定搭配：raise / sound the alarm 发出警报；报警
G. 固定搭配：in alarm 惊恐地
H. 固定搭配：a fire / burglar alarm 火警／防盗警报器

items.q: the alarm went off at four
an alarm is the only thing in a house
The alarm clock on the shelf
There was no alarm in the new houses

answers.why: alarm 意为“警报、警报声”，1976 年凌晨四点警报响了，而祖母始终不知道那个声音是什么意思。
alarm 意为“误报的警报、虚惊”，她说警报是家里唯一一样生来就要出错的东西。
alarm clock 意为“闹钟”，架上那只闹钟是全街唯一走得准的钟。
raise the alarm 意为“发出警报、报警”，1968 年学校那堵墙移动时他发出了警报，却什么也没做。
in alarm 意为“惊恐地”，1976 年母亲惊恐地醒来，抱着弟弟就往外跑。
alarm 意为“警报装置、报警器”，到 1981 年新房里没有警报装置，也就是墙上没有那个盒子。
alarm 意为“惊恐、惊慌”，1984 年信到的时候，她脸上那次惊恐是我唯一见过的一次。
a burglar alarm 意为“防盗警报器”，1986 年他装了防盗警报器，却从未打开过。

她说，警报是家里唯一一样生来就要出错的东西。（alarm）
架上那只闹钟是全街唯一走得准的钟，祖父四十年里每晚九点给它上弦。（alarm clock）
1968 年学校那堵墙移动时他发出了警报，人们向他道谢，却什么也没做。（raise the alarm）
1976 年母亲惊恐地醒来，抱着弟弟就往外跑，连外套都没穿。（in alarm）
1986 年他装了一个防盗警报器，却从未打开过。（a burglar alarm）
